description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Gangodawila, Sri jayawardenapura Kotte D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 521601
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, owner names, extent of land, title classifications, and encumbrances/mortgages. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including land registrations, property ownership, and land titles as specified in Type 4 classification.
